testcase: UNNEST filter referencing covered keyspace on build side of hash join

explain.statement: SELECT true AS present FROM $explan AS p WHERE ANY v WITHIN p.plan.`~children` SATISFIES v.`#operator` = 'HashJoin' AND ANY w WITHIN v.`~child`.`~children` SATISFIES w.`#operator` LIKE 'IndexScan%' AND w.`as` = 'b' AND array_length(w.`covers`) > 0 END END AND ANY u WITHIN p.plan.`~children` SATISFIES u.`#operator` = 'Unnest' AND CONTAINS(u.`filter`, 'cover ((`b`.`room_type`))') END

statements: SELECT b.booking_id, h.name, rt.price * b.room_count AS total FROM shellTest b JOIN shellTest h USE HASH(probe) ON b.hotel_id = h.hotel_id UNNEST h.room_types AS rt WHERE b.type = "cfbooking" AND h.type = "cfhotel" AND rt.name = b.room_type AND b.checkin >= "2023-10-01"

testcase: Join filter of nested-loop join on expression term referencing covered keyspace

explain.statement: SELECT true AS present FROM $explan AS p WHERE ANY v WITHIN p.plan.`~children` SATISFIES v.`#operator` = 'NestedLoopJoin' AND v.`alias` = 'x' AND CONTAINS(v.`filter`, 'cover ((`b`.`room_type`))') END

statements: SELECT b.booking_id, x.p FROM shellTest b JOIN [{"n": "Garden View", "p": 1}, {"n": "Traditional", "p": 1}] AS x USE NL ON x.p = b.room_count WHERE b.type = "cfbooking" AND x.n = b.room_type AND b.checkin >= "2023-10-01"

testcase: Join filter of nested-loop join with primary scan on inner, during join enumeration

explain.statement: SELECT true AS present FROM $explan AS p WHERE ANY v WITHIN p.plan.`~children` SATISFIES v.`#operator` = 'NestedLoopJoin' AND v.`alias` = 'h2' AND v.`filter` IS NOT MISSING AND ANY w WITHIN v.`~child`.`~children` SATISFIES w.`#operator` LIKE 'PrimaryScan%' END END

statements: SELECT b.booking_id FROM shellTest b JOIN shellTest h2 USE NL ON b.hotel_id = h2.hotel_id WHERE b.type = "cfbooking" AND h2.name = b.room_type

testcase: Join filter of nested-loop join inside subquery term on inner of nested-loop join

explain.statement: SELECT true AS present FROM $explan AS p WHERE ANY v WITHIN p.`~subqueries` SATISFIES v.`#operator` = 'NestedLoopJoin' AND v.`alias` = 'h2' AND v.`filter` IS NOT MISSING END

statements: SELECT h.name, s.booking_id FROM shellTest h JOIN (SELECT b.booking_id, b.hotel_id FROM shellTest b JOIN shellTest h2 USE NL ON b.hotel_id = h2.hotel_id WHERE b.type = "cfbooking" AND h2.name = b.room_type) AS s USE NL ON s.hotel_id = h.hotel_id WHERE h.type = "cfhotel"
